a) Square plates are 20-30 cm; this looks like a medium dinner-size square plate, so about 25 cm.
b) Reference: the plate's width spans roughly the length of the potato pieces and greens cluster. The plate fills most of the frame width; estimating about 2.5-3 fork lengths (19 cm each) across suggests about 25 cm.

Likely a bit less because of air gaps; use ~90 g.
- Cooked spinach/leafy greens: covers about 22% of plate area (~140 cm²), mostly a mound on the right. Average thickness about 1.5 cm (wilted leaves, mound peaks near 3 cm). Volume = 140 × 1.5 = 210 ml; cooked leafy greens density 0.6 → ~126 g.
- Shredded carrot: thin scattered strands among the greens, about 15 g total (small amount, roughly 0.3 cm layer over ~30 cm²: 9 ml × 0.6 ≈ 6 g; round up to ~10 g to account for the visible quantity).

Hidden food: no base layer or sauce is apparent; the plate appears to be a single layer with no hidden stack. No extra items added.

- Roasted potatoes (cooked with some oil): about 130 kcal/100 g.
- Cooked spinach (lightly sautéed, likely with a little oil): about 35 kcal/100 g.
- Carrot (raw/shredded): about 40 kcal/100 g.

Totals: potatoes 90 g, greens 126 g, carrot 10 g; total about 226 g. Energy ≈ 117 + 44 + 4 ≈ 165 kcal.
